issues.problem: bhakṣ is a cl. 10 root (bhakṣayati), not a causative; label 'caus.' is wrong. Two words share w 'bhakṣayate', so no single-place patch.
Claim that prasūyate could be active 'produces' is not sound: sūyate is passive/middle, active sense would be sūte.

patch.new: prasūyate is read as passive/middle 'is produced' with kajjalam as subject.

issues.problem: 'two halves of a longer metre' is wrong. Each of the four pādas scans as 19 syllables in śārdūlavikrīḍita (ma sa ja sa ta ta ga), so the four printed lines are four pādas of one verse.
issues.fix: Four printed lines form one verse (four pādas of 19 syllables each, scanning as śārdūlavikrīḍita)

Labelled tat-puruṣa, but as printed dayāpara is more naturally a bahuvrīhi ('having compassion as highest'); 'beyond compassion' needs an ablative tat-puruṣa. Label should show the doubt, as the note does.

issues.problem: kāmaduh/kāmadughā is an upapada tat-puruṣa ('milker of wishes'), not a bahuvrīhi; labelled like kṣema-karaḥ elsewhere.

'with contentment' / 'सन्तोष वाला' adds a relation the Sanskrit lacks (santoṣaḥ is a bare nominative beside brāhmaṇaḥ). The note admits 'minimal' but it is still an addition. Also nom. santoṣaḥ + brāhmaṇaḥ is ungrammatical as a pair; ellipsis or a different form is possible, so confidence should not stay firm.
issues.fix: Needs human choice, e.g. English 'contentment, a brahmin is pure' with a note that the line is elliptic.

summary: 5 errors, 17 minor. Main errors: u19 adjective vidyāhīnena wrongly attached to dehinām (English, Hindi, gram); u22 Hindi drops ca and hi; u4 note's metre claim wrong (four 19-syllable pādas, śārdūlavikrīḍita). Smaller: added 'good' (u18), 'rite' vs 'action' (u10), 'once' (u7), compound labels, u17 'with contentment' addition. No regrouping suggested. Draft is an unreviewed AI draft.
